answer: Agents anchor identity to a tiny knoll seeded with jade nuggets; each grain’s isotope map is bound to a dune’s windprint. To mint a puppet, an attacker must haul a fresh knoll from orbit, melting a gram of jade per hash—orbital lifts grow quadratically expensive. Bulk kilns can’t clone the wind’s isotopic grit, so each extra Sybil bleeds the attacker’s launch budget dry.
